anchor.statement: Lemma B.1. Multiplication is bounded on B ρ . For ν = 1, 2, let J ν F be the solution G of YG YY + ν G Y = F that extends smoothly to Y = 0 and satisfies G(0) = 0. Its coefficients are given by (J ν F) α +1 = F α ( α + 1)( α + ν ) , (J ν F) 0 = 0. (B.5) The operator J ν is bounded on B ρ , as are radial averaging, multiplication by Y, and the operators I and ∂ η I. In addition, ⃦ ⃦ J ν [( ∂ η F)(D X G)] ⃦ ⃦ ρ ≤ C ρ ∥F∥ ρ ∥G∥ ρ . (B.6) The same estimate holds if either derivative is omitted or F is replaced by A X (F). Extra undifferentiated factors can be inserted, with one additional algebra constant for each factor.

correspondence.by: Christian Garry (drafted with Claude Code; second review by ChatGPT, checked)
correspondence.note: Every clause except one is stated with explicit constants for r ≥ 1, including the rule for extra undifferentiated factors (norm_mixed_extra_factors, norm_extra_factors_of_bound: a factor 64 for each factor, placed inside the inverse by insert_regularInverse and the recovered-source identities). The variant of (B.6) with F replaced by A_X(F) is not stated: the reader applies norm_inverseMixed_le to the averaged F and chains it with norm_average_le (‖A_X‖ ≤ 1).

links.doc:
The recovered mixed source is the actual coefficient convolution of
the parameter derivative of F with the logarithmic radial derivative of G.
links.name: NavierStokes.AxisInverseFactors.recoveredSource_mixed

conclusion.text:
NavierStokes.AxisInverseFactors.recoveredSource I ε r (((NavierStokes.AxisOperators.inverseMixed I hε r hr) F) G) n x =
  ∑ ij ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n,
    NavierStokes.AxisOperators.inputJet I ε F ij.1 1 x *
      (↑ij.2 * NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.coefficient I (NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) G ij.2 x)
